decisions: No TapoCloudClient change: the app makes no cloud call for a camera rename (verified in jadx).

Owned cloud cameras (role 0): setDeviceAlias via the camera's route (LAN or passthrough); name applied at once as pending_name, rolled back on failure (command_failed 'rename_camera' + rename_finished(id, msg)); pending cleared when the cloud alias matches or after 24 h. A rename to the current cloud alias still sends the command but sets nothing pending.
Shared cloud cameras: local display_name that refreshes never overwrite; 'Reset to camera name' restores cloud_alias. Manual cameras: CameraConfig.name changes (local only).
Validation = app rules (trim, 1..32 UTF-8 bytes) plus NFC composition and refusing control characters (this app's additions).

Sort: QCollator(QLocale() = system locale unless the app sets a default), numeric mode, case-insensitive; ties keep account order; setting camera_sort (name_asc default | name_desc | account); grid slots never move.
FakeCameraService.rename is added by a phase7 autouse monkeypatch, so tests/e2e fakes are untouched.
open_issues: Default list order changed from account order to A-Z (as requested); 'Account order' in the sort menu restores the old behaviour.
How fast the TP-Link cloud reflects a new dev_alias is not in the APK and was not measured (only no-op renames were allowed); the 24 h pending window covers the delay.
Camera-side alias rules beyond 32 bytes (e.g. emoji) are unknown; any refusal is shown with the camera's error code.
